project_type: Full-stack AI SEO SaaS Platform - Next.js frontend + NestJS backend + Python AI microservices
test_framework: Jest for unit tests, Playwright for E2E (frontend), Jest for backend
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install from root. 2. Run pnpm build to verify TypeScript compilation. 3. Run pnpm lint to check code quality. 4. Run pnpm test to run unit tests.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client generated via 'pnpm --filter backend prisma generate'. No checked-in snapshots.
setup_instructions: 1. export PATH=/opt/node22/bin:$PATH. 2. pnpm install from repo root. 3. Copy .env.example to .env and configure. 4. pnpm --filter backend prisma generate.
environment_constraints: Node.js v22.15.0 at /opt/node22/bin. pnpm 11.2.2. Python 3.12 available. Docker available but SSL cert issues with some registries - prefer host-based builds. Must export PATH=/opt/node22/bin:$PATH before any node/pnpm commands.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - establishing conventions. Use conventional commits. TypeScript strict mode. ESLint + Prettier for formatting.
key_patterns: Monorepo with apps/web (Next.js), apps/api (NestJS), packages/shared (types/utils), packages/database (Prisma). ShadCN UI components. Zustand stores. React Query for data fetching. NestJS modules with controllers/services/DTOs pattern.
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/web (Next.js 14 App Router), apps/api (NestJS), packages/database (Prisma schema + client), packages/shared (shared TypeScript types and utilities)
